contexts.text: The very least things are directed by the Lord's Providence, even as to the very steps.
The manner of walking in Jupiter. Explained.

Man cannot stir a step without the influx of Heaven... It has been granted the Angels to move my steps, etc. as they pleased, by influx into my will and thought... Man prays that God will send His Angels to direct his steps...
Infants (here) must learn to walk, etc. It is different in the other life... They walk without practice. Explained.
When any Spirit fixes his attention upon the steps of any horse, and speaks at the same time, he is heard exactly as if the hoofs of the walking horse were speaking.
That mere equilibriums exist, has been shown by my steps...
When I have counted the footsteps in the street...
(Spheres in connection with man's stepping.) SE 4474.
They have hunted our steps, so that we cannot go in the streets () = a leading astray by falsities, so that it is not known how to live.
The sole of the footsteps of the king of Assyria () = the Sensuous, and the derivative reasoning, which is from mere fallacies.
Hence it is that the Angels of the Third Heaven know the quality of a man from his stepping, etc.
The Lord's advent is meant by His goings in the sanctuary ().
